description: Per-class numerators with Wilson intervals and the discarded-as-unknown share, Kaplan-Meier survival of directive adoption by cohort, directive lineage, declaration growth, and RFC 9728 auth-discovery conformance detail — none of it on the free surface — with an ed25519 attestation naming the chain head it was derived from. FREE SAMPLE, no credential: https://atlas.geosensor.tech/free/sample. Price $0.02 or €0.02 via x402 v2 in USDC or EURC; a credential is VERIFIED and then SETTLED before anything is returned. A €19/month subscription at https://atlas.geosensor.tech/paid/subscribe (19000000 atomic units) needs no per-call payment. TESTNET only (Base Sepolia): settlement is on-chain but moves test tokens with no monetary value. The tokens on this network are free from https://faucet.circle.com, and you need no ETH because the facilitator pays the gas.
